title: Assistance Plan Output Types V1 (the closed vocabulary the create route accepts)
$comment: DL-KB-08. GET /api/assistance-plan-output-types answers with this document. The initial screen must offer an output type before any project exists, so the vocabulary cannot ride the project-scoped list route; it also cannot be hand-copied into TypeScript, because a second table would let the page offer a word the service refuses. Every value here is exactly what `assistance_plan.OUTPUT_TYPES` accepts, and the label is the Chinese name the screen shows for it.
